Oysters natural.d: On crushed ice, shallot and red wine vinegar mignonette, cracked pepper.
Oysters natural.note: Half a dozen, with lemon. Up from the Cape daily.

Fish and chip cones.d: Cod in a cold lager batter, thick potatoes done twice. Tartar sauce and lemon.
Fish and chip cones.note: Served in a paper cone at the oyster bar.

Whole lobster.d: About 1¾ lb from our tank, split, brushed with garlic butter and finished under the broiler. Drawn butter and lemon.

Ocean blue jelly cups.d: Coconut cream set firm under a clear sea-blue layer, gummy fish on top.
Ocean blue jelly cups.note: From the main room dessert cart.

Blue lagoon.d: Vodka and blue curaçao over ice, topped with lemon-lime soda and a lemon wheel.
